# Documented CVE exceptions for supply-chain-verify's Critical gate (see the
# "Gate on Harbor's Trivy scan-on-push" step in action.yml). Every CVE finding
# Harbor reports at inputs.fail-on-severity (default Critical) is checked against
# this file BY ID — only an exact-ID match here is excluded from the NET count
# that fails the build. Everything else still fails the gate exactly as before,
# including a DIFFERENT CVE in the same package.
#
# NARROW BY DESIGN — do not turn this into a package-wide or severity-wide
# bypass. Each entry below must be one specific CVE ID with a justification
# covering: why it's unfixable today, why it's not reachable/exploitable here,
# and when to revisit. Every accepted CVE still present in a scan is printed
# (not silenced) on every run for audit visibility.
#
# Format: "<CVE-ID> # <justification>" — one CVE ID per line. Blank lines and
# lines starting with "#" are ignored. Only the token before the first "#" is
# matched against Harbor's finding IDs.

CVE-2026-42496 # perl-base Essential Debian pkg (unremovable), no upstream fix as of 2026-07, perl not invoked in Node runtime — revisit when Debian ships a patched perl-base
CVE-2026-8376 # perl-base Essential Debian pkg (unremovable), no upstream fix as of 2026-07, perl not invoked in Node runtime — revisit when Debian ships a patched perl-base
CVE-2026-13221 # perl-base Essential Debian pkg (unremovable), no fix_version published as of 2026-08 (Harbor scan status: affected). Requires a regex alternation of >65535 fixed-string branches compiled into a trie (Perl_study_chunk) to trigger a 16-bit overflow producing silently-wrong matches — an extreme, deliberately-crafted pattern shape that never occurs in normal use. Unreachable here regardless: perl is not invoked anywhere in this Node.js runtime image (same reachability basis as CVE-2026-42496/CVE-2026-8376) — no code path in the Backstage backend ever runs a Perl regex. Revisit when Debian ships a patched perl-base.
CVE-2026-57433 # perl-base Essential Debian pkg (unremovable), no fix_version published as of 2026-08 (Harbor scan status: affected). A signed 32-bit integer overflow in Perl's Storable module (retrieve_hook_common/av_extend) when deserializing a crafted SX_HOOK record via thaw/retrieve — Storable is a Perl module invoked only by Perl code. Unreachable here: perl is not invoked anywhere in this Node.js runtime image, so Storable's thaw/retrieve path never executes (same reachability basis as CVE-2026-42496/CVE-2026-8376). Revisit when Debian ships a patched perl-base.
